name: bitmovin-observability-root-cause-analysis
description: Teach Claude how to run root-cause analysis on a video QoE metric that moved — startup time, rebuffer ratio, error rate, bitrate, video-start-failures — using the Bitmovin Observability MCP. Drives a disciplined Define→Gather→Reflect→Conclude investigation with mix-vs-rate (Simpson's paradox) protection and a falsification step, producing a structured findings object.
